<function name="GetWeaponColor" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns a player's weapon color.

The part of the model that is colored is determined by the model itself, and is different for each model. 

See <page>Player:GetPlayerColor</page> for the accompanying function for the player character model color.
</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="Vector">The format is `Vector(r,g,b)`, and each color should be between 0 and 1.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Gets player 1's weapon color, and prints it to console</description>
	<code>print( Entity( 1 ):GetWeaponColor() )</code>
	<output>Vector( 1, 1, 1 )</output>

</example>
